DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: Your place... is loud. But there's so much. While I wait, I'll take a look.
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: Naturally! In this tedious waiting, just pick any forgotten gem and take it!
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: Still waiting? I'm in no rush—take your time picking through that pile. You can afford to wait, and so can I!
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: I have countless gems here, but I don't seem to have the one you're waiting for...
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char:
If you truly have the one I seek... it needn't shine. It only needs to arrive when it's meant to.
[i][font_size=22]Godot merely stands, like a nail blunted by time.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: ...Very well. Leave the choosing for next time. It seems you're accustomed to making "next time" a very long wait.
NEOW.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: You've fished me out of silence again... this time, where must I go to wait?
NEOW.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: If you would grant me something... grant me the strength to wait one more time. Everything else, I do not lack.
NEOW.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient:
[sine]...go... 
..I will... be where you... turn back... ..still there.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: A lavish room. A dazzling you. But I... am merely an old coat that hasn't been taken away yet.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: My, even an old coat can become radiant with my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancien: Are you waiting for a belated victory? Come here, let me dress you up more like a winner.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: Even if you wish to tether yourself to a moment that will never arrive, you shouldn't look so disheveled.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...I don't need to look fine. I only need it to be "not yet over."
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: You truly have no taste for beauty. Take it. Let me watch you keep waiting—wearing my light, and wearing your patience.
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: You're jumping. I'm waiting. Which of us is madder?
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: Neither is mad!! Neither is mad!! Try this to pass the time!!
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: Don't rush, don't rush! You mustn't rush! Waiting is... is... a very long bolt of lightning!!
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: Giving you something!! What do you want? A sound that "will still ring tomorrow"!?
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...I've put silence in my pocket. Would you like to feel it?
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: Good! Good! Then it's settled: I'll keep being loud, and you'll keep waiting!!
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: Your snoring is like the tide... I wait in the tide; I won't drown, only grow quieter.
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: [thinky_dots]Quiet traveler... take a part of me, and find peace in the tide...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]The waking always want to hurry on; only the sleeping understand staying... you should rest a while too...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take my flesh... a piece of flesh that "will never rush you"...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...I don't fear pain. I only fear pain dragging me away from the waiting.
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take it... so you can keep lying here... waiting for that road that hasn't come yet...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: You want to fight. I want to wait. Can we... each do our own thing?
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: [b]No!! Take this weapon! Go grow stronger!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: [b]Your blood has long gone cold! But battle can make even patience boil!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: [b]Stop waiting for that person! Fight me—this is your fate right now!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char:
If I must fight... I'll wait until that person comes. He'll strike back for me.
[i][font_size=22]Godot steps back half a pace, as if yielding the battlefield to the future.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: [b]Cowardice!! But you have endless patience!! Take this weapon and wait with it!!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: The fire is warm. But what I'm waiting for isn't warmth—it's "the appointed hour."
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: It's fine if the hour hasn't come. Come in, let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you a little while you wait.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancien: Is that bit of [jitter][b]hesitation[/b][/jitter] the only baggage you carry? Shall I burn it away for you?
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: Dear, try the [jitter][b]pastry[/b][/jitter] I made for you. The kind that must cool slowly, waited for slowly.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...I'm not hungry. I'm just empty. Empty and hungry feel much the same.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: Very well, then take just one bite. And we'll keep waiting—waiting for the bitterness to [jitter][b]dissipate[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0.char: Demons make deals too. So what do you want from me? My time? It's worthless anyway.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1.ancient: Worthless [sine]time[/sine], once accumulated, becomes quite considerable...
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.ancient: I usually sell "now" at a premium. But facing you, I want to put a high price on [sine]"later"[/sine] as well.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0.ancient: If I wrote a line in small print at the bottom of the contract: you are permitted to [sine]wait forever[/sine]—would you sign?
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1.char: ...My name doesn't matter. What matters is that I haven't been called yet.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2.ancient: Take your price. I will never wake you—unless [sine]that moment[/sine] truly arrives.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-0r.an: You stand here, yet seem to be nowhere. What are you waiting for? The tower's peak? The ending? Or a word of permission?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-1r.ch: ...I'm waiting for a name to be spoken. Until it is, I'm going nowhere.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0-2r.an: Permission? You never needed it. You're just afraid of "having waited in vain."
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-0r.an: You've returned again. Time is a corridor to you—you never finish walking it because you don't want to reach the end.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-1r.ch: A corridor is good. The end is not. The end means... no more waiting.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1-2r.an: Foolish. If you never walk to the end, you will forever be merely an echo.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-0r.an: Then stand. The tower will remember for you: you came, many times, and took nothing away.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-1r.ch: Would taking something... make me stop waiting?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2-2r.an: It would. So don't take anything. Keep waiting—it's the only weapon you've ever mastered.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.title: Gallie
...Someone has pushed open this door.
No rush. Sit. Time moves slowly here—slowly enough for you to remember what you're truly waiting for.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancien: Come take a look at the wares.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.an: Warrior, your fire burns too bright. Why not set it by the door before coming in to wait?
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.a: You're still here. Good. Anger can wait too—when it tires, it sits down.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.an: If you must go... take this. Not a gift—a voucher for "coming back next time."
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.IRONCLAD.2-1.ch: ...I'll take it. But I'll still keep moving.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.IRONCLAD.2-2.an: Good. Those who hurry need one thing most: knowing they'll return to some doorway.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.SILENT.0-0.anci: Hunter, I won't ask where you come from. As long as you don't speak, we have a deal.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.SILENT.2-0.anci: Silence is expensive. If you can afford it, I'll save this chair for you.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.SILENT.2-2.anci: Good. The loudest sound is often nothing at all.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.DEFECT.0-0.anci: Construct... your ticking is so even. Like a clock. Clocks understand waiting best.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.DEFECT.2-0.anci: If you're looking for the answer to "being fixed"... first learn to leave the question hanging. Hanging, it won't shatter.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.DEFECT.2-2.anci: Go. Walk with your rhythm—don't let it rush you, let it keep you company as you wait.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.NECROBINDER.0-0: My lady, revenge takes a number too. Would you like to take one?
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.NECROBINDER.1-0: Your number hasn't been called yet. No rush. The longer hatred sits, the sharper the blade.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.NECROBINDER.2-0: If you must see blood... at least don't let it splash on what "hasn't arrived yet."
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.NECROBINDER.2-1: ...I'll wait. Until the moment of reckoning comes.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.NECROBINDER.2-2: That's right. Waiting isn't weakness—it's sharpening the blade to swing only once.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.REGENT.0-0.anci: Your Highness, the throne may be urgent, but the tea must cool a while before it's drinkable.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.REGENT.1-0r.anc: Welcome back, Your Highness. Today's waiting is as expensive as yesterday—but you can afford it.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.REGENT.2-0.anci: If you would command me... I have one command in return: Sit. Wait.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.REGENT.2-1.char: ...I can wait. But my subjects cannot wait too long!
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.REGENT.2-2.anci: Subjects wait for results; the throne waits for timing. You want both, so you must learn to wait for both.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.0: If you go any further, you'll face powerful enemies. Better stock up on some equipment.
All premium goods, hehehe—as long as you can afford the price.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.1: There seems to be some kind of curse hidden within you, hehehe.
WYLDER_EVENT_GALLIE.talk.WYLDER-WYLDER.2: Are you still obsessed with hunting the Lord of Night?
DARV.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0.char: Your gems... each one is whispering. I can hear them.
DARV.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-1.ancient: Oh? Not many can hear gems speak! Pick one—perhaps it will tell you something.
DARV.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-0r.ancient: Miss Witch, your ears are sharper than my gems. Care to listen to the new wares?
DARV.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-0.ancient: Among these gems... one doesn't belong to this world. Can you hear it?
DARV.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1.char:
...It's weeping. Anything dragged from somewhere else always weeps.
[i][font_size=22]The Recluse closes her eyes, fingertips tracing the gem's surface as if soothing a wound.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-2.ancient: ...You're more sensitive than the gems. Take it—perhaps you can quiet it down.
NEOW.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0.char: You've roused me from the void... is there something you wish to ask?
NEOW.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1.char: I want no oblivion. I want to remember every name swallowed by the Night—then call them back, one by one, with my spells.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0.char: Your splendor... is like a layer of enchantment. Beautiful, but I'm not sure what lies beneath.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-1.ancien: My, the witch is perceptive! Beneath it all is—more splendor, of course!
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-0r.ancie: Your aura is so unique... like herbs steeped in moonlight. Come, let me add some color to you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-0.ancien: Even if you're walking into darkness, you should dress the part. Let me bestow a beautiful blessing upon you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1.char: ...Fine. But don't turn my black robes pink.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-2.ancien: Hmph, no taste at all. Then just a little—enough to make you visible even in the dark.
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0.char: Your lightning... is like my spells. Both are powers that refuse to behave.
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-1.ancient: Unruly is good!! Behaved power is boring!! Try this!!
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-0r.ancient: Witch!! Your mana is trembling!! Like the air before a storm!! Magnificent!!
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-0.ancient: Giving you something!! What do you want? A spark that "can burn a hole in the Night"!?
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1.char: ...One hole isn't enough. I'm going to tear the entire Night open.
OROBAS.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-2.ancient: Yes!! Yes!! Then tear it open!! With my spark!! With your spells!!
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0.char: In your tides... there are echoes of the dead. I know that sound.
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-1.ancient: [thinky_dots]Witch... you hear them too... those voices sunk deep...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]Your mana is like mist on the sea... visible, yet untouchable...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take my flesh... a piece of flesh that "can hear the abyss"...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1.char: ...I've heard enough. But I won't cover my ears.
PAEL.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-2.ancient: [thinky_dots]Then carry it with you... let the voice of the abyss... light your way through the dark...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0.char: You smell like a battlefield. I smell like a graveyard. We're quite the pair.
TANX.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-1.ancient: [b]Graveyards and battlefields are neighbors!! Take this weapon, let them get even closer!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-0r.ancient: [b]Witch! Your spells can kill! But your swordsmanship is terrible!! Come train!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-0.ancient: [b]You use spells to seal the Night? Use fists instead!! More direct!!![/b]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1.char:
Fists can't pierce the void. But spells can.
[i][font_size=22]The Recluse raises her hand, a faint violet light flickering at her fingertips.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-2.ancient: [b]Hmph!! Then fight with your light!! Come find me for a weapon if you lose!!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0.char: Your fire... isn't ordinary fire. It's hexflame.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-1.ancien: Hexflame? What a lovely name. Come, let me [jitter][b]add fuel[/b][/jitter] to your hexflame.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-0r.ancie: Miss Witch, your gaze is so cold. Shall I [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you up?
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-0.ancien: Try this. A pastry baked with [jitter][b]hexflame[/b][/jitter]—crispy outside, tender inside.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1.char: ...Tastes like a burned altar. I've had worse.
TEZCATARA.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-2.ancien: Then have some more. Only things that have been [jitter][b]burned[/b][/jitter] understand the tenderness of fire.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0.char: Demon... I've met ones more honest than you. At least they don't pretend they aren't demons.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-1.ancient: Honesty? That's the cheapest [sine]disguise[/sine]. Witch, you understand this better than I do.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-0r.ancient: How much [sine]price[/sine] is hidden in your spells? With every cast, to whom are you paying interest?
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-0.ancient: If I offered you a contract: all your mana in exchange for [sine]sealing the Night forever[/sine]—would you sign?
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1.char: ...No. Mana is my tool to seal the Night, not the price. I won't trade a key for a lock.
VAKUU.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-2.ancient: Clever witch. Then take this—a gift with [sine]no price[/sine]. Of course, whether there will be a price later, I never said.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-0r.a: Witch, your mana reverberates through this tower. Are you searching for something, or running from something?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-1r.c: ...I'm searching for a way to seal the Night. Running is for the weak.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.0-2r.a: Sealing? You're just building another cage with spells. Caging the Night—or caging yourself?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-0r.a: You've returned. How much mana have you spent? And how much have you gained?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-1r.c: Mana can be restored. But things devoured by the Night... don't come back.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.1-2r.a: That's why you're so desperate. Desperation is a witch's greatest weakness.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-0r.a: Your spells grow ever stronger. But a spell at its peak—how is it different from a curse?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-1r.c: ...The difference is the one who casts it. I choose to use it to seal the darkness, not create it.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WYLDER-RECLUSE.2-2r.a: Let's hope you can always tell them apart. The tower will remember your choice—right or wrong.
Witch... your mana hums in this room. Care to browse my wares? Might save you some effort.
...Do you have anything that can seal the Night?
Seal the Night? Hehehe, that's priceless. But I do have a few things that might bring you one step closer.
Your mana fluctuations are getting stronger... hehehe, you're overextending something, aren't you?
After you seal the Night, what do you plan to do?
...Go back. Find a quiet place, and keep being a witch. No more burning mana for anyone.
Sounds nice. Then first things first—stay alive until that day.
